_comment: Expected port/protocol profiles for IoT device categories. Used by the protocol audit endpoint to flag unexpected traffic — if a device communicates on ports outside its category profile, it is flagged as anomalous. Profiles are intentionally permissive (common ports included) to reduce false positives.

camera.label: IP Camera / Security Camera
camera.notes: 80/443 = web UI and cloud API; 554/8554 = RTSP video streaming; 8080/8443 = alternative web UI and management ports; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP time sync

smart_speaker.label: Smart Speaker / Voice Assistant
smart_speaker.notes: 443/8443 = cloud API and voice processing; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP; 5353 = mDNS for local discovery; 1900 = SSDP/UPnP for device discovery

thermostat.label: Smart Thermostat
thermostat.notes: 443 = cloud API; 8883 = MQTT over TLS; 1883 = MQTT plaintext; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP

smart_plug.label: Smart Plug / Smart Outlet
smart_plug.notes: 443 = cloud API; 8883 = MQTT over TLS; 1883 = MQTT plaintext; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP; 6668/6669 = Tuya IoT protocol (used by many smart plugs and switches)

smart_tv.label: Smart TV / Streaming Device
smart_tv.notes: 80/443/8443 = streaming services and cloud API; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP; 5353 = mDNS; 1900 = SSDP/UPnP; 8008/8009 = Chromecast/Google Cast; 9080 = secondary streaming or DIAL protocol

hub.label: Smart Home Hub / Bridge
hub.notes: 80/443/8443/8080 = web UI and cloud API; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP; 5353 = mDNS; 1900 = SSDP/UPnP; 8883/1883 = MQTT; 25105 = Insteon protocol

doorbell.label: Smart Doorbell / Video Doorbell
doorbell.notes: 443/8443 = cloud API and video upload; 554/8554 = RTSP video streaming; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP

light.label: Smart Light / Smart Bulb
light.notes: 443/80 = cloud API; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP; 5353 = mDNS; 1900 = SSDP/UPnP; 8010 = Philips Hue local API and similar protocols

sensor.label: IoT Sensor (motion, temperature, humidity, etc.)
sensor.notes: 443 = cloud API; 8883 = MQTT over TLS; 1883 = MQTT plaintext; 53 = DNS; 123 = NTP

default.label: Unknown / Uncategorized IoT Device
default.notes: Baseline profile for unrecognized devices — only common web, DNS, NTP, and discovery ports. Any traffic outside these is flagged for review.
